decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Location and Site Plan, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, D100, D101, D102, D103, D104, D105, D106, D107. Received: 12/05/2025. 050-A. Received: 03/06/2025. 201, 203, 205, 207. Received: 24/09/2025. 200-B, 202-A, 204-B, 206-B. Received: 24/09/2025. 210. Received: 09/12/2025.

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - The first-floor windows formed in the western side elevation shall be obscure-glazed below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.  
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the western and eastern side elevation of the development hereby permitted. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site other than under the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and E shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority. 
Reason:  To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site.

Condition : 8 - The car parking accommodation (including any electric vehicle charging points) shown on the approved drawing(s) shall be provided before the dwelling(s) to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles associated with the residential occupation of the property and shall be permanently retained 
Reason:  in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety.

Condition : 9 - The hardstanding hereby permitted shall be made of porous materials, or include provision to direct surface water run-off to a permeable or porous area or surface within the application site, in accordance with the (then) Department for Communities and Local Government publication "Guidance on the permeable surfacing of front gardens" dated September 2008 before the building(s) hereby permitted is first occupied. The run-off shall not drain into any other foul or surface water drainage system.  
Reason: In order to reduce surface water run-off and the associated pressure on local drainage systems and so prevent flooding.

Condition : 12 - Prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations [and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority], aligned with the [Sustainable Drainage Strategy (SuDS) Report (Rev_A)) Received:09/12/2025] and associated material hereby approved. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.
Reason: In order to prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site.

Condition : 13 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components. 
Reason: In order to ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.

Condition : 14 - (a) The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy. 
(b) Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions, and achieved a 99% reduction in emissions. 

Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.

Condition : 15 - No development shall take place until the applicant has entered into a binding arrangement with the Council to make an agreed contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Energy Statement hereby approved to an amount that equates to the shortfall in required energy savings to meet the 'zero carbon' target. 
Reason: In order to ensure the development meets sustainability standards.

Condition : 16 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.
Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.

Condition : 17 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than three bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed as shown on approved plan no. 204-B. The approved facilities shall conform to the current West trans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 18 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on approved plan no. 204-B shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway.
Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.
description: Erection of a self build two storey self-build detached house following the demolition of the existing bungalow.
